name: norsk-lesson-factory
description: Open Norwegian Bokmål lesson data plus the agentic QA pipeline used to build and maintain it.

scripts.eval:prompt: for config in evals/promptfoo/*.yaml; do npm run eval:promptfoo -- -c "$config" || exit $?; done
scripts.eval:promptfoo: PROMPTFOO_PYTHON=$(uv run which python) npx --yes promptfoo@0.122.2 eval --no-cache --no-write --max-concurrency 1
scripts.check: npm run conventions:check && npm run format:check && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy src/ && npm test && npm run eval:exercise-quality && uv run lesson-data regenerate-dist --repo-root . && git diff --exit-code -- dist/lessons dist/catalog.json dist/schema/lesson.schema.json && uv run lesson-data check --workspace-root . --format json && npm run knowledge:validate
